name: What needs to be done before kitchen drywall can be installed?

mainEntity.name: What needs to be done before kitchen drywall can be installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before drywall installation begins, all plumbing, electrical wiring, gas lines, and HVAC ductwork must be fully installed and inspected. Homeowners should also confirm that wood backing or blocking is fastened between the wall studs where heavy cabinets, floating shelves, or range hoods will hang. It is also important to clear out all appliances, cookware, and adjacent furniture to protect them from drywall dust. Confirming the locations of all under-cabinet lighting outlets and appliance receptacles beforehand prevents having to cut into newly finished drywall later.
acceptedAnswer.description: All rough-in plumbing, electrical, and gas work must be completed, and solid wood backing for heavy cabinets or range hoods must be installed before hanging drywall.
